visual_action: A montage of clips shows Donald Trump on a golf course. He is seen driving a golf cart with another man, getting out of the cart, and swinging a golf club.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the person shown in all the clips on the golf course, and the on-screen text refers to 'Trump'.

cast.name: unnamed man
cast.evidence: An unidentified man is shown sitting next to Donald Trump in the golf cart in the opening shot.

on_screen_text.text: Trump after signing the “poor people don’t deserve to live” bill

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; the audio consists of the lyrics to the song "Rock That Body."
audio_music: An upbeat, high-energy pop/dance track ('Rock That Body' by The Black Eyed Peas) plays throughout the video. Its celebratory tone creates a stark, mocking contrast with the grim (and fabricated) event described in the on-screen text.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between several different clips of Trump on the golf course.
manipulation_or_satire: The on-screen text satirically claims Trump is golfing after signing a fictitious and cruel bill titled the 'poor people don’t deserve to live' bill. This text is superimposed over real footage of him golfing to create a false, mocking context for his actions.
cultural_references: The Black Eyed Peas (song 'Rock That Body')
central_claim: Donald Trump is a cruel and callous person who would casually enjoy a game of golf after passing legislation that harms poor people.
intended_effect: To generate mockery and contempt for Donald Trump by portraying him as indifferent to the welfare of the poor.
